system.notes: One-shot overload flash; replace after use. High-powered one-shot: battery and bulb replaced after every use (10¥ each, or six for 50¥). Affects targets directly in front; no Combat Test: each target resists Serious Stun against TN 12 − meters away; + visual-test TN equal to boxes taken, fading 1 per minute; GM-optional opposed Reaction test if facing is disputed. Visible 3 km; seeps through a building floor (Blast in a Confined Space, SRII p.97, Power 12 −1/m). Each use: 2D6, on 2–3 the user is blinded and must replace the cybereyes. Priced as an addition to the BrightLight system. (Cybertechnology, table p.96, p.21, p.46.)
